Run a custom GA4 report with arbitrary dimensions and metrics.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `options.dimensions` | `string[]` | required | GA4 dimension names |

| `options.limit` | `number` | `undefined` | Row limit |
| `options.save` | `boolean` | `true` | Save results to JSON |

## Workflow Pattern

Every analysis follows three phases:

### 1. Analyze
Run API functions. Each call hits the Google APIs and returns structured data.

### 2. Auto-Save
All results automatically save as timestamped JSON files to `results/{category}/`. File naming pattern: `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS__operation__extra_info.json`

### 3. Summarize
After analysis, read the saved JSON files and create a markdown summary in `results/summaries/` with data tables, trends, and recommendations.

selected_processing_gaps.reason: cd changes shell cwd only on success. Its status output does not supply the resolved cwd value; the command summary does not materialize that conditional binding separately.
The lockfile identifies candidate package locations. Cache versus network selection, concrete install transfers and installed state after a failure are not established.

The config call may read the default .env under initialization cwd and populate environment bindings. Its JavaScript return is discarded; the subsequent post-state is distinct. The source does not establish identity with the documented project root, exact merge outcomes, or an unconditional environment replacement.

The second-resolution filename and sanitized labels allow path collisions. Internal saver deliveries summarize the same conditional directory creation, timestamp, metadata wrapper and persistent replace at each call; the payload or returned path is not the serialized content. The supplied write has no file-content output.

Selection is by sorted candidate path and optional full-path substring, then a fresh acquisition from the first path. There is no run identifier, saved-path handoff or validation establishing which analysis wrote it. A parsed JSON null can also be returned normally.

The Skill requires post-analysis saved-JSON reading and a Markdown summary with tables, trends and recommendations in results/summaries/. No executable successor, file association, exact summary input projection or writer is supplied. EM01–EM04 and EM10 retain possible observation of the whole parsed version acquired for that purpose, without exposing internal text by implication or making all fields necessary. The automatic-save obligation coexists with executable guards, child save suppression and the empty bulk bypass.
The Skill lists GA4 relative objects broadly; Search Console source requires YYYY-MM-DD yet passes objects unchanged. No conversion or service acceptance of relative object fields is established.
The absent predecessor contributes JavaScript undefined with no declared operand. The format cannot bind an undefined literal; null would change the returned value and serialization.

The normal child projection has a clock acquisition only when latestUpdate.notifyTime is falsy. The compact projection does not separately bind that conditional sample. The exceptional delivery case retains the attempted request but does not distinguish rejection from an acquired response followed by a projection exception; neither establishes eventual index state.
The Skill and index describe clicks; the reference describes impressions. The actual page request specifies no sort, so the returned ranking cannot be assigned from these conflicting descriptions.
